name: Something smells fishy...
description:
🎣 Fishy SMP — Java + Bedrock Cross-Play Survival

Cast your line, stay a while.

• Proximity voice chat — hear players near you, Bedrock included via a web client

• Fair play — modern async anti-cheat, no pay-to-win

• Active community — Discord chat bridged straight into the game
